description: This is a source file implementing the SiftBackend class for handling event processing, configuration, and communication within a backend system, specifically related to the Sift analytics component.

classes.name: SiftBackend
classes.description: Implements the backend logic for collecting, processing, and uploading analytics events, managing configuration, event queue, and background thread.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the backend with the provided system shell and system time, initializing internal configuration object.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Queues an event to be processed and sent by the backend system.

methods.name: ActionLoop
methods.description: Main background thread loop that processes queued actions, manages configuration, and handles event sending.

methods.name: SendEventInternal
methods.description: Constructs a JSON representation of an event and sends it to the store, returning success status.

methods.name: GenerateRandomCharacter
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random byte.

methods.name: GenerateRandomOctetString
methods.description: Creates a hex string composed of random bytes.

methods.name: GenerateRandomUUID
methods.description: Generates a UUID string following RFC 4122 version 4 format, using cryptographically secure randomness.
